outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 430 grandmultiparous women (parity 5 or more) were compared with a multiparous population (parity 2-4).
finding: Grandmultiparity was significantly associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes including cesarean delivery, fetal macrosomia, diabetes mellitus, and pregnancy induced hypertension, but not with other adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly more common in grandmultiparous women.
